summary: Iteration 143: a targeted retest of the 142 fixes. Frontend code only; no app code was edited. (A) Studio GET gate in api.js. A Node VM unit test with a controlled fetch passed 6/6: max in-flight is 3 for the 7 studio GETs and they drain in FIFO order; a network error releases its slot and gives the standard 'Connection interrupted' message; a 503 releases its slot and carries status and retryAfterMs; aborting a queued request or an active one rejects, releases and does not hang, and a fresh batch gets 3 slots again; non-studio GETs, studio POST/PUT/DELETE and /auth/refresh are never gated; a 401 refresh with the gate full retries all 7 with no deadlock. Browser check through the isolated bridge on 127.0.0.1:8791 (page.route -> route.fetch, NO semaphore, owner 'w'), 2 cold loads of /studio at 1920x800: browser-side studio in-flight max was 3 and overall /api max was 3. All 16 studio GETs per load returned 200. These were the 7 required (sets, imports, chapter-books, mock-books, ai-review, solve-tests, question-report-priorities) plus jee-transfer and all-india-jee, each fired twice because of React StrictMode mount/abort. There was no 503 capacity_busy, no busy text and no Retry. Fault injection: connection-reset on sets/imports with 400ms latency on the rest. The queue drained (active 0 at the end), max stayed 3 and the error was shown. (B) Theme at 1920x800 and 390x844. Inactive result-view tabs (Progress, Confidence, ...), Physics/Chemistry solution-subject tabs and inactive exam-destination links (Chapter tests, My results) hover to bg #28131A, white text and border #94303E, which differs from rest. The 'FAIL' rows in the raw log are only the tablist container and count badges hit by the broad selector. Selected tabs are #D91222 with white text (5.17:1). Confirm dialog: 'Go back' is variant=outline, bg #14141C with a #67202C border, and hovers to #280D13; 'Submit & see results' is #D91222. Go back closes the dialog and stays in the player. Chart legend text is #B0B0BF on #14141C (8.55:1), and the strong labels are 17.5:1. Retry link (variant link, #FF6974): student-reports-retry 6.56:1, my-tests-retry 6.20:1. The Studio 'server is busy' span is 6.81:1. Clicking Retry recovered. The 404 card has 20px gutters on mobile and 330px on desktop. Mobile player: integer Q21/Q22 focused from near the sticky bar ends fully above it after 400ms (e.g. 703-753 -> 439-489, bar at 775). Values 17 and -3 saved with PUT 200 and show 'All responses saved'. The source canvas parent is white with filter none. Keyboard '2' saved value B (PUT 200). scrollWidth equals the viewport on results, pyq, 404, studio and profile. Studio editor asset GET still returns 503 capability_held, the deliberate operator hold, with an error code distinct from capacity_busy. Not run: the backend pytest suites (no backend changes since 142, as instructed) and the full 45-route repeat. Cleanup: the bridge stopped with 'DROPPED True' for tejas_isolated_iter134. The customer DB was not touched and there was no real owner login.

issues: Short page: the footer ends at about y=735 with about 110px of empty body background below it. Cosmetic only; optional min-height or a sticky footer.

critical_code_review_comments: fetchStudioRead: a waiter whose signal is aborted while still queued is only rejected when it reaches the head of the queue and gets a slot. There is no hang, but a cancelled request holds its place behind up to 3 slow requests. Optional: listen for options.signal 'abort' to splice the waiter out early.

The gate is per browser tab and releases on response headers, before the body is read. Two Studio tabs, or an owner plus a reviewer at the same time, can still exceed control=4 on the server and get 503. That case has no auto-retry with Retry-After. This matches the documented 'not a capacity promise'.
Studio asset/image GETs through api() share the same 3 slots as list reads, so large editor assets can delay list loads. This is a performance note only.
